language.title: Language
language.copy: Binder is written in English. A language appears here as soon as its file is added.
language.systemCopy: Use the device language when Binder has it, English otherwise.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.copy: Dark is the designed default. System follows your device and can turn Binder light.

motion.title: Motion
motion.copy: Reduced motion keeps every state change, it just stops animating them.

haptics.title: Haptics
haptics.copy: Short vibrations mark thresholds and confirmations.
haptics.label: Vibrate on interactions

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.copy: Match, message, moderation and product pushes wait until the local end time. Urgent safety alerts remain immediate.
quietHours.label: Use quiet hours

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.copy: Optional technical events only. No bio, messages, raw stack traces or precise location.
diagnostics.label: Share optional diagnostics

reset.confirmCopy: Appearance, motion, haptics, accent, notification categories and quiet hours return to their defaults. Your profile and conversations are untouched.
reset.done: App settings are back to their defaults.

errors.connection: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.registered: This email is already registered. Sign in instead.
errors.passwordLength: The password must be at least 8 characters.

messages.passwordChanged: Password changed. You are signed in.
messages.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Open it on this phone.
messages.accountCreated: Account created. Confirm the email, then sign in.

headers.recoveryCopy: Choose something you have not used here before. You stay signed in on this device.
headers.resetCopy: Enter the address you signed up with and we will send a link to set a new password.
headers.defaultCopy: Dating for adults. Mutual interest before conversation.

fields.repeatPasswordHelper: Both entries have to match before the account is created.

actions.signInPrompt: Already have an account? Sign in

auth.ageRequirement: You must be at least 18 years old to use Binder.

notifications.title: Message alerts
notifications.unavailableCopy: Push notifications are not supported on this device. Chat still works normally.
notifications.offlineCopy: Could not reach the push service. Check your connection and try again.
notifications.blockedCopy: Android is blocking Binder notifications. Allow them in system settings.
notifications.enabledCopy: Notification categories can be adjusted in App Settings.
notifications.copy: Opt in to alerts for new matches and messages.

empty.title: A Bind starts together
empty.message: When you and someone in Discovery both choose Bind, they appear here and either of you can start the conversation.
empty.conversations: Your conversations will appear here after the first message.

accessibility.photosReviewed: Photos reviewed before appearing in Discovery
